title: Storm Client
description: An Optimization Modpack with PVP features
body:
Fabric based Optimization Modpack with multiple Fps boosting Mods. Storm Client also has many pvp mods.This modpack is based on vulkan a mod that changes the rendering API from Opengl to Vulkan wich is much faster. you can expect more fps and smoother gameplay.
the main mods that are used in this pack are:
Vulkan mod
bad optimizations
ccme
dynamic fps
entity culling
ferrite core
scalable lux 
very many players.
i got an fps boost from 300 fps to over 1000!
